basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (Astronomy Astrophysics and Space Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Astronomy Astrophysics and Space Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Indore has advertised 2 Junior Research Fellow posts in a 3-year research project funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The fellowship for GATE or NET qualified candidates is 37000 + 20% HRA if living outside. The essential qualification is a Master's degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) with First Class in the listed or related disciplines. age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 years, with relaxation as per Government/Project guidelines. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and gives no relaxation amounts.

qualification.details: Master's degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) with First Class in any of the following or related disciplines, or relevant domain: | Physics / Applied Physics Atmospheric Science / Meteorology Climate Science / Environmental Science Earth System Science Remote Sensing and GIS Space Science and Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering Data Science / Computer Science

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Towards improved understanding of atmospheric tipping points: a multiple-sensor study of aerosol-cloud-precipitation interaction over central India
GATE or NET qualified: 37000 + 20% HRA if living outside
Within 21 days from the date of advertisement (23-11-2026), about 14 December 2026, or until the vacancy is filled

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) with First Class in any of the following or related disciplines, or relevant domain: Physics / Applied Physics Atmospheric Science / Meteorology Climate Science / Environmental Science Earth System Science Remote Sensing and GIS Space Science and Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering Data Science / Computer Science GATE / CSIR-UGC NET / UGC-NET qualification Knowledge of Python, MATLAB, satellite data processing and atmospheric data analysis Experience in aerosol, cloud and precipitation studies The age limit is 35 years, with relaxation as per Government/Project guidelines. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and gives no relaxation amounts.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship for GATE or NET qualified candidates is 37000 + 20% HRA if living outside. The duration of the appointment is 3 years. The selected candidate will be encouraged to register for the PhD program at IIT Indore as per institute norms. If selected for the PhD program, a fellowship will be extended for the PhD duration as per institute norms.

content_sections.text: Research on aerosol–cloud–precipitation interactions using multiple sensors and WRF Thermodynamic profile retrieval AI/ML based nowcasting over Central India

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts are there at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The notice announces 2 Junior Research Fellow vacancies in the Department of Astronomy Astrophysics and Space Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore JRF posts?
faq.answer: Applications are due within 21 days from the date of the advertisement, 23 November 2026, which is about 14 December 2026, or until the vacancy is filled.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) with First Class in the listed disciplines, such as Physics, Atmospheric Science, Remote Sensing and GIS or Computer Science, or a relevant domain, is the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, with relaxation as per Government/Project guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: GATE or NET qualified candidates receive 37000 + 20% HRA if living outside.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Indore JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Email a detailed CV with degree certificates, mark sheets, GATE certificates and date of birth proof in a single PDF file to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, the date of which is to be announced. Selected candidates are informed by email.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Indore JRF post a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a research project post with a duration of 3 years under an ANRF-funded project.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the selected JRF register for a PhD at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be encouraged to register for the PhD program as per institute norms. If selected for the PhD program, a fellowship will be extended for the PhD duration as per institute norms.
